name: Macro & Mixin Misuse
essence: Metaprogramming expands or mixes behavior the reader never sees.

examples.summary: Promoted `Save` calls `BaseModel.Validate`, never the embedding `User.Validate`; invalid users save.
examples.mechanism: Struct embedding is composition, not inheritance; there is no virtual dispatch through the embedded receiver.

examples.summary: Copying a struct that embeds `*Stats` shares the counters between both handlers.
examples.mechanism: Embedded pointer is copied as a pointer; promoted fields alias the same Stats.

examples.summary: `clamp_max!` expands `$val` twice, so the side-effecting reading is consumed twice.
examples.mechanism: macro_rules! substitutes expressions textually; bind `$val` to a local once.

examples.summary: `skip_blank!` contains `return`, which exits the whole import instead of skipping one line.
examples.mechanism: Control flow inside a macro acts on the caller's function, invisible at the call site.

examples.summary: `vec![Rc::new(..); N]` clones one Rc N times; every lane is the same buffer.
examples.mechanism: The repeat form of vec! uses Clone, which for Rc shares the allocation.

examples.summary: Two mixins define `validate`; the later silently overwrites the earlier, so the email check never runs.
examples.mechanism: Object.assign is last-write-wins on key collisions.

examples.summary: Cached wraps Authorized, so the cached report is served after the token is revoked.
examples.mechanism: Mixin application order determines the super chain; caching outside auth bypasses it.
examples.observed_output:
before revoke: quarterly revenue report
after revoke:  quarterly revenue report

examples.summary: A class-decorating helper stores `calls` on the prototype, so all instances share one array.
examples.mechanism: Mutable state on a prototype is shared by every instance.

examples.summary: Record.save returns audit, because Audit is listed before Store.
examples.mechanism: Attribute lookup walks the MRO left to right. The first base that defines save wins.

examples.summary: Record.save records the audit step and never reaches Store.save.
examples.mechanism: Calling Audit.save directly skips the rest of the MRO. super().save() would continue it.

examples.summary: One charge(10) appends 10 twice and returns 20.
examples.mechanism: The wrapper calls the wrapped function for a side effect and again for the return value.
